title: Bug: wrong concatenation pfcwd docker image url due to ansible upgrade
author: wenjwang-nv
body:
### Is it platform specific

mellanox

### Importance or Severity

Critical

### Description of the bug

In deploy_pfcwd_fanout.yml, the way to concatenate pfcwd docker image it not supported anymore in ansible >2.19.  The url contains extra '/' and invalid ']' suffix, which will lead to request failure and block all pfcwd tests.

### Steps to Reproduce

run ansible job check_pfcwd_config

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

ansible job should pass

### Relevant log output
